searchText: Hey guys, I am trying to understand slashing processing and correlation penalty in-depth. The eth2book says the formula is the following: But the code on the GitHub is the following: This doesn't seem the same or am I missing something? The min function already has different arguments than the formula from eth2book suggests When "simplifying" the code I get => B/(increment^2 * T * min(3*S, T)). Yeah, doesn't seem the same 😅 I've just done a back-of the envelope check and my calc (Upgrading Ethereum author here!) looks correct. The two `increment`s cancel each other out, so you've got something upside down. Ahhh it seems I did the same mistake few times over and over again before I realised. 😅 Thanks!
